We moved our job queue from Redis to Postgres last quarter. Throughput dropped about 15 percent, which we expected, and on-call pages for the queue went from roughly one a week to zero since March. The main reason is boring: one less thing to back up and restore. I wrote up the migration steps and the two mistakes we made with advisory locks.
